derivation: A top-level two-branch block's join routes directly to a second block's split. outer-a has completed and discharged its branch obligation, and outer-b's matching effect now arrives. PAR-001 discharges outer-b's obligation with its direct basis; the pass is then complete, so the join fires in the same transition and both obligations become JOINED. LIFE-015: when the pass joins, the successor removes the joined BRANCH segment and every region-local segment after it, retains the common outer prefix, here empty, and appends only segments the continuing closure introduces, so each second-block branch occurrence carries exactly its own BRANCH segment at pass 1. Their predecessor lists and the new obligations' source lists are the raw UTF-8 sorted completion frontier of the joined pass, the two direct final occurrences. The ROUTE detail names outer-b's relationship to the join and the join's outgoing relationship, and both blocks, because the closure traverses the first block's join and the second block's split.
